messages:
Marta: quick sync — we need to lock down connector naming, lifecycle, and credential rotation for Private control plane handoff. This touches agent bootstrap, DNS, and metrics. TL;DR: propose short-lived connector IDs + human-readable stable alias + periodic rotation of signing keys. Thoughts?
AJ: +1 for stable alias + ephemeral id. Alias used in DNS/metrics (e.g. acme-prod) and ephemeral id for auth: conn-<uuid>-v<rot>. avoids DNS churn.
Katie: metrics continuity concern — if the id flips every rotation our dashboards break.
Marta: agreed. plan: dashboards reference alias. agent reports both alias and connector_id in every handshake. example payload: 
```
{ "alias": "acme-prod", "connector_id": "conn-8a3f...", "issued_at": 1700000000 }
```
John: credential rotation question — are we doing 1h tokens jittered or longer lived? on-prem could be flaky.
Sasha: for on-prem, very short tokens hurt reliability. propose 24h access tokens signed by rotating keypairs, with a 7-day overlap window for key rotation. rotate keypair weekly.
AJ: agree. also add a refresh endpoint the agent calls prior to expiry; if the agent is offline it can continue until a max grace (72h) then go to degraded state.
ops-bot: scheduled: connector-key-rotation job created for 2024-11-01T02:00Z :alarm_clock:
Katie: DNS/endpoint ownership: avoid creating per-connector A records. use stable CNAME per alias pointing to a customer pool LB. ephemeral connectors register themselves into the pool via control-plane registration.
Marta: also need audit logs to record both alias and ephemeral id for every handshake and which signing key id was used. we'll add fields to the handshake log schema (alias, connector_id, key_id, issued_at).
John: migration plan idea: 3-phase rollout — opt-in for existing customers, default-on for all new Private deployments, forced rotation after 90 days for remaining agents.
Sasha: noted. i'll draft an RFC with lifecycle state machine examples (provision -> active -> draining -> revoked) and a small sequence diagram for handshake.
Marta: action items: @Sasha draft RFC by EOD Friday, @AJ update agent bootstrap to emit alias+connector_id, @Katie update dashboards to prefer alias fallback. thanks all :thumbsup:
